title: AITA For making my girlfriend return an expensive gift?
question: AITA For making my girlfriend return an expensive gift?
body: My girlfriend of around 5 years got me a gift for Christmas. She got me a nice new laptop because she knew my old one was slow and she wanted me to have the best. She said that it’s something I deserve. She said that she would return it if I wanted her to and I think I want to. I don’t want to return it because it isn’t nice - it is- I want to return it because I feel like it’s too much for me. I feel like it’s something that I do deserve and need, but I feel like a high end gift like this is something I can’t accept from anyone for whatever reason. I told her I want to return it and she said she doesn’t want me to. Am I the asshole for telling her I want to return it?
